ranked.headline: Histology and spatial context are being fused to model tissue-resolved gene expression
ranked.summary: Spatial omics methods now pair histology, graph weighting, and regularization with gene-level priors to resolve tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Graph and tensor methods integrate incomplete spatial and single-cell multiomics data
ranked.summary: Recent items extend spatial multiomics methods to incomplete, cross-platform, and protein-level data, mostly as preprints.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence encoders learn drug, protein and cell representations for prediction
ranked.summary: Learned encoders are increasingly paired with network, causal, or grammar-based priors to predict drug interactions, target prioritisation, and cellular…

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict gene regulation and perturbation responses across scales
ranked.summary: February 2026 items pair flow matching, foundation models and DNA language models with perturbation and cis-regulatory prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Chromatin accessibility, histone marks and contacts linked to regulatory outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair accessibility, histone, methylation and contact data with statistical and learned models of gene regulation.

ranked.headline: Orthology-driven tools compare protein function and trait evolution across species
ranked.summary: Comparative tools now lower the computational barrier to orthology, tree-based trait profiling, and functional enrichment across species.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomes at single-cell resolution infer methylation, mutations, and lineage
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics are now being used to infer methylation activity, somatic mutations, and metastasis-initiating cell states.

ranked.headline: Generative models are learning protein dynamics and coupling sampling to density data
ranked.summary: Generative models now produce microsecond-scale MD-like trajectories and GPCR-ligand dynamics, explicitly aiming to replace costly simulation.

ranked.headline: Priors and generative models test whether single-cell readouts capture true cell states
ranked.summary: Sparse, error-prone single-cell data demand explicit biological priors or generative models to validate per-cell readouts.

ranked.headline: New tools integrate single-cell and spatial omics for regulatory and coverage inference
ranked.summary: Integration parameter choices and multi-omics frameworks now directly shape single-cell conclusions, which makes systematic benchmarking and tool validation…

ranked.headline: Constraining learned molecular models via synthesizability, mass, and rule priors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple flow matching, GFlowNets, and language models with explicit chemical, physical, or synthesizability constraints for design.

ranked.headline: Open tools expose annotation, variant, and repurposing criteria to direct interrogation
ranked.summary: Reproducibility depends on making annotation diagnostics, variant criteria, and negative sets inspectable rather than implicit in pipeline code.

ranked.headline: Allele-separated analysis of polyploid and heterozygous plant genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C haplotype assembly now yields near telomere-to-telomere autotetraploid potato genomes, with allele-aware tools extending to expression and…

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for coevolution, genotype-phenotype mapping, and viral RdRp detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications present Python and standalone tools for sequence comparison, coevolution, metagenomic features, and genotype-phenotype…

ranked.headline: Workflows and benchmarks for bacterial genome, resistance, and plasmid analysis
ranked.summary: Long-read assembly and simulated-metagenome benchmarks now allow direct comparison of tools against defined ground truth.

ranked.headline: Network priors and robustness to correlation and missingness in multiomic integration
ranked.summary: Network priors on cross-omics features are entering multiomic models that must handle correlated, high-dimensional, and partially missing data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts biomolecular interactions via multi-source feature fusion
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint work pairs transformer and fusion architectures with multi-source features to predict protein, drug, and microbe interactions.

ranked.headline: Single-nucleus atlases link histone marks and transcription across brain regions
ranked.summary: Multimodal single-cell profiling of histone marks and transcriptomes now resolves regulatory elements across human and mouse brain at cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: Computational methods refine noncoding RNA quantification and regulatory inference
ranked.summary: Quantification artifacts and single-cell regulatory inference now constrain how noncoding RNA activity is measured across tissues and disease states.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models explain state transitions and oscillations in cellular processes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply parameterized mechanistic models to gene circuits, signaling networks, and plant bud dormancy.

ranked.headline: Variational inference resolves alleles, haplotypes, and variant mixtures
ranked.summary: Uncertainty-aware latent-variable models now address genotyping, fine-mapping, trans-eQTL discovery, and virus mixture quantification.

ranked.headline: Scalable graph and state-space deep models across histology, transcriptomics, and EHR
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair linear-time or graph architectures with whole-slide, single-cell, spatial, and EHR data, spanning histology to disease progression.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed learned models capture conformational ensembles of proteins and RNA
ranked.summary: Learned structure predictors now yield ensemble-level outputs that can be constrained by molecular mechanics or energetic terms.

ranked.headline: Learned models delineate tissue and anatomy in gigapixel pathology and imaging data
ranked.summary: Foundation-model adaptation and cellular-resolution masks now target throughput and quality control for whole-slide and spatial omics imaging.

ranked.headline: New methods test and compare spatial gene patterns with formal statistical inference
ranked.summary: Spatial omics datasets now call for pattern-level tests with calibrated inference, scalable to single-molecule data and embryogenesis-scale atlases.

ranked.headline: Protein language models infer mutation effects on stability, function and PAM specificity
ranked.summary: Sequence-based models are being applied to decompose mutation effects, from TCR escape variants to Cas PAM specificity and recurrent substitutions.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for simulation, modeling, module detection, and single-cell scoring
ranked.summary: Five February 2026 published tools extend network simulation, metabolic modeling, multi-omics modules, 3D genome visualization, and single-cell scoring.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biomolecular models repurposed for fitness, variant, and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Protein and genome language models are being reused beyond their pretraining objectives, with new tokenization, pooling, and decoding schemes.

ranked.headline: Software platforms standardize downstream analysis of biological measurements
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair standardized multi-instrument processing with natural-language, template-based plotting for bioinformatics outputs.

ranked.headline: Sample structure and data quality limit inference in ancient DNA datasets
ranked.summary: Simulations and metadata audits expose how multi-contributor samples and inconsistent dating constrain ancient genomic inference.

ranked.headline: Open GWAS tools extend conditional analysis and meta-analysis to multi-ancestry data
ranked.summary: Multi-ancestry GWAS summary statistics need joint and conditional methods, and new tools now address them with faster implementations.

ranked.headline: Structural and in silico profiling of missense and synonymous variant pathogenicity
ranked.summary: Databases and classifiers now extend deleterious-variant prediction to synonymous sites and to saturation missense mutagenesis across structural contexts.

ranked.headline: Mosaic STR mutations, CNVs and oligogenic risk resolved across human genome cohorts
ranked.summary: Single-cell, biobank-scale and trio-based analyses now resolve mosaic, copy-number and oligogenic variation in human genomes.

ranked.headline: Shared benchmarks and open workflows are reshaping DIA proteomics quantification
ranked.summary: Multi-lab benchmarks and new DIA software now test acquisition, quantification, and statistical choices against shared reference data.

ranked.headline: Structural and transposable element dynamics shape plant, fish and fly genome evolution
ranked.summary: Reference-free pangenome methods and chromosome-level assemblies now resolve TE bursts and plastome rearrangements at fine evolutionary scales.

ranked.headline: Dynamics-aware methods probe folding intermediates, pKa shifts, and ligand binding sites
ranked.summary: Trajectory-based and proteomic tools now link conformational dynamics to residue ionization, ligand binding, and folding structure data.

ranked.headline: Pipelines cutting compute cost for long-read and population-scale genome assembly
ranked.summary: Nanopore and GPU-accelerated pipelines now target recomputable, population-scale genome analysis at lower compute cost.

ranked.headline: Electric fields can override and reverse durotaxis in a cell-type-dependent manner
ranked.summary: Quantitative models now predict how competing physical cues and cell morphology jointly steer directed cell migration.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking batch correction and QC tools for mass spectrometry and cfDNA data
ranked.summary: Batch effects in large MALDI imaging cohorts and routine proteomics QC now have dedicated analysis software.

ranked.headline: Computational MS/MS methods for structure, similarity and microbial drug metabolism
ranked.summary: Cross-polarity spectral similarity, iterative de novo elucidation, and community-level tracing now address unannotated metabolites in microbiome studies.
